entries.en: ... anybody. Is there anyone picking this up?
Get away from that radio.
[static] ... this is Juliana Baynham of Feros colony. Please help us... [static]
That's my mom. Stop. Stop the rover.
That's my mom!
We've reached the station. No hostiles in sight.
You owe us for this. The skyway is crawling with geth.
Package is secured. We're leaving now.
Wait, shut down the comm! We've got incoming geth! Damn it, shut down the comm!
Keep your guard up. This place is probably crawling with geth.
I think this situation falls under the "shoot on sight" category.
This was a research facility. A place of learning and knowledge. It should not have become a slaughter house.
We're not going to find many survivors in this base.
Time to clean this place out.
I doubt anyone's still alive in here. The geth are very thorough.
Looks like the geth are settling in nicely.
This area seems almost... serene. Typical geth pantomime of organic behavior.
Are they meditating? Why would a machine do that?
You've got to be kidding me. Are they praying?
This area seems almost... serene. Intriguing behavior for a machine.
This area seems shrine-like. Why would a machine do that?
Lizbeth must have run when the power dropped. Let's follow her lead and find the exit.
Lizbeth must have run when the power dropped. Finding an exit sounds good.
Young Lizbeth must have run when the power fell. We should follow her lead and find an exit.
Lizbeth must have run for an exit when the power dropped.
Lizbeth probably ran for the exit when the power fell and the fields dropped.
Resistance will be extremely heavy once we are inside.
Doesn't matter. We're their eviction notice.
They want something here. Why else would they bother with all this?
They must want something from the ExoGeni systems. Why else would they bother with all this?
What are they up to? There's no point to this unless they are looking for something.
The geth don't need much of an invitation to move in, do they?
The geth have moved in rather quickly.
The geth certainly don't waste time moving in.
The geth are quick to move in.
No way to burn through this shield with the weapons we have. We'll have to find another way in.
Ain't getting though this with the gear we have. Has to be another way in.
Our weapons can't touch a field like this. We'll need another way in.
We can't scratch this field. We need another way in.
Typical geth deployment. We'll need another route in.
Looks like a one-way trip down, Commander.
One-way drop, Commander.
A one-way trip down, Commander Shepard.
This looks like a one-way drop, Commander.
A one-way drop, Shepard.
Any other situation and I'd say it was a... shrine or something.
If they're looking for God, I can speed them on their way.
Intriguing behavior for a machine species.
Why would a synthetic devote resources to something like this?
Whatever. I ain't here to "learn their customs."
Stupid machine! Access encrypted files!
Can't you geth straighten this thing out?
No, I don't want to review protocol!
I am unable to comply. Please contact your supervisor.
Damn it. Tell me what I want or I'll blast your virtual ass into actual dust!
Please contact your supervisor for a Level 4 security exemption or make an appointment with--
Stupid machine!
If there is nothing else, please step aside. There is a queue forming behind you for the use of this console.
Oh good. I really need to kill someone!
ExoGeni Corporation reminds all staff that the discharging of weapons while on company property is strictly forbidden.
